ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light gray) distal fields vs 40% low-intensity (black/dark gray) central-proximal fields.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A central contiguous low-intensity region radiates from the peduncle to the median notch; high-intensity white fields occupy the distal two-thirds of both lobes; isolated low-intensity speckles are visible on the distal right lobe field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped vertex with an interior angle of approximately 45 degrees and deep penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency irregular serration along the entire trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the distal edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric sigmoidal curve; exhibiting concavity in the area proximal to the notch and transitioning to convexity towards the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-texture clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible on the high-intensity field of the right lobe, oriented diagonally to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of surface-attached matter on the distal tips; distinct dark linear rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The demarcation line between the central dark pigmentation and the white lobe fields is highly irregular and asymmetric across the midline.
